formerNames.effect: not authorized for the current repository or GHCR writer

formerNames.status: transferred; the GitHub API answers HTTP 301 to repository id 1347790742
formerNames.effect: a repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN can only write packages in the current owner namespace; the former namespace answers permission_denied: The requested installation does not exist

repository.bindingRule: every release workflow proves GITHUB_REPOSITORY == repository.fullName and lower(GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER) == registry.namespace before it authenticates to the registry; a further transfer fails closed instead of publishing to a stale namespace

registry.namespaceDerivedFrom: lower-cased repository owner (GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER); never a historical literal
registry.packageVisibility: private (inherits the repository visibility on first publication by the repository workflow; the package is linked to the repository by that publication)

identities.writer: GITHUB_TOKEN of the repository's own workflow runs: .github/workflows/release.yml on push to main (authoritative candidate) and .github/workflows/release-preflight.yml on same-repository pull requests (preflight only); permissions contents: read, packages: write
identities.reader: GITHUB_TOKEN of the promotion, certification and drift workflows (packages read through the repository link) and the staging/production deploy identity, which is provisioned outside Git and pulls by digest only
identities.personalAccessToken: not used; no shared or universal registry credential exists
identities.forkPullRequests: never receive packages: write; the preflight workflow refuses head repositories other than repository.fullName

tagPolicy.authoritative: sha-<40 lowercase hex git sha of the protected main commit>
tagPolicy.preflight: preflight-sha-<40 lowercase hex git sha of the pull-request head>; proves build, publish, digest and attestation capability; never promotable and never a release authority
tagPolicy.digestAuthority: the OCI image index digest reported by buildx (containerimage.digest) and re-read from the registry with imagetools inspect; every consumer (release manifest, compose, promotion) references <image>@sha256:<digest>, never a tag

attestations.provenance: BuildKit SLSA provenance (--provenance=mode=max) attached to the published image index and extracted into the release evidence as standby-provenance.json
attestations.sbom: BuildKit SPDX SBOM (--sbom=true) attached to the published image index and extracted into the release evidence as standby-sbom.spdx.json with its sha256 bound in the release manifest
attestations.githubArtifactAttestations: not used: would require id-token: write and attestations: write; the BuildKit attestations already bind builder, source revision and digest

retention.authoritativeImageVersions: immutable; never deleted or retagged by automation
retention.preflightImageVersions: immutable per pull-request head; may be pruned by a repository administrator, never by a workflow token

promotion.authority: tools/verify_release_candidate.py: staging and production promote the exact protected-main candidate (run id, artifact digest, manifest sha256, image digests) and never rebuild, re-resolve or retag
promotion.rollbackReference: release-manifest rollback_source_sha plus the previous candidate's image digest and configuration sha256 recorded by the staging certification
promotion.runtimeApply: no release evidence authorizes a runtime apply; deployment remains a separately reviewed change with runtimeApplyAuthorized false everywhere in this repository
